Verdict

## Numbers `renderdiff: 9 of 9 routes differ (32 of 63 shots), 0 errors`. Left = head (working tree of gro-1143), right = base 17ce7e299. Base vs base on the same routes and widths: 0 of 63 shots differ (one 37 px unstable spot at /product/embedded-analytics@375). Clean at 375, 1100 on every route; clean at 1600 on every route except /blog/metabase-doesnt-use-php. ## What I saw - **@1000 (992–1023 band), all 9 routes**: nav is the hamburger header, promo banner hidden; lg layouts become md (home BI panels stack, events grid 2-col → 1-col, upgrade plans stack, blog content 904 → 664 px wide). Expected. - **@1440 (1400–1535)**: nav GitHub "50k" stars hidden; home `.home-container` 1320 → 1140; learn left sidebar collapses into the TopBar drawer; upgrade plan cards 421 → 451 px; blog grid narrower. Expected. - **@1240 (1200–1279)**: home, blog, upgrade containers 1140 → 960 / cards reflow; learn content padding; /changelog TopBar hides "What's new"; pricing/events nav width. Expected. - **@600 (576–639)**: home, blog, upgrade, learn go full-width (container 540 → none); pricing/events nav full width. Expected. - **Legacy nav alignment**: /product/embedded-analytics clean at 600, 1240, 1600 and /changelog clean at 600, 1600: nav keeps the Bootstrap container and stays aligned with content. ## Unexpected 1. **Regression, /changelog @1000 (992–1023)**: `.learn__post__content` is 40 px wide. The TopBar now moves the left sidebar into a drawer below 1024, but the legacy grid `.learn { grid-template-columns: 226px 1fr }` in `src/styles/legacy/learn/styles.scss` still collapses only at `max-width: 991px`, so the article lands in the 226 px column. Confirmed by measurement at 992 and 1023 (40 px) vs 991 and 1024 (678 / 422 px). Same layout: /changelog/*, /search, /paid-features. 2. **Blog @1600 (outside every band), +60 px**: the bottom-of-article newsletter iframe is ~620 px wide, so its own viewport sits in the 576–639 band; its `sm:grid-cols-[1fr_124px]` now stacks the Subscribe button under the email field. Correct for `sm`=640, but visible on every blog post at wide desktop widths where the article column is 576–639 px. ## Not verified Only 9 marketing routes; no hover/open-menu states (nav dropdowns, opened hamburger); videos/GIFs and iframes masked (`maskMedia`). Reference is a local base build, not production. ## Call Expected breakpoint change everywhere except two findings: a real regression on /changelog (and other `Docs.astro`/`Changelog.astro` pages) at 992–1023, and a minor iframe-driven newsletter layout change on blog posts at 1600.

    • iframes (--mask-media)

    Pinned on both sides: clock starts at 2026-10-30T15:51:00.000Z on every load, a seeded Math.random, timezone UTC, locale en-US, light colour scheme, reduced motion, CSS animations and transitions off, animated images and SVG animations held on their first frame, videos kept from playing with video.js overlays hidden.

    Unstable pixels — ones that changed between two shots of the same load — are painted magenta on both sides, counted on each card, and excluded from the measurement. A route more than 25% unstable is an error.

    Magenta is also padding where one page is taller or wider than the other. It counts against the score on purpose — see the height delta on the row.
